scientific_decisions.choice: New decoder reads learned same-word affinities as mutual graph edges within each existing word instance. Axial radius1/4 edges and two-step max-min diagonal paths avoid directional asymmetry; connected components of reliable edges yield candidate cores. Never merge existing instances. Split only if at least two cores each satisfy minimum4coarse cells/15%instance fraction and cover70%. Skip geometric-only coarse disconnections. Restore all fine pixels by seeded8-neighbor geodesic length flood; preserve foreground exactly.

Motivation is actual fused-word failures (AIRPORTS -> PACIFICAIRPORTS; Prydes -> Prydestport) and dilution of rare weak internal links by the rejected mean-closedness score. Keep winning v2 global epoch6 weights and parameters unchanged. This is a new instance decoder, not a newly trained backbone or worldwide novelty claim.

CAL100 tunes four graph thresholds plus exact no-graph control and nine confidence cutoffs. Five image-group folds require >=0.5F1points over both cross-fitted no-graph and fixed CAL baseline. Only a qualified nontrivial decoder proceeds to TEST300, with matched no-graph control at the same selected confidence. No further TEST evaluation on failure.

Verified RTX3090 FP32 batch1, native PARSeq batch32. Inherit cache only with pinned SHA; exact CAL probability replay guards model/crop identity. Record actual new OCR calls and memory; cached timing is not online latency. No DeepSolo.

Whether ownership fields distinguish word boundaries, whether cuts recover merged words without splitting legitimate words, coarse-to-fine sampling and single-seed/historical CAL/TEST exposure. Local transport, mean closedness and long negative continuation are not reused as claimed successes.
